title: Trinity flash explained away as an ammo dump accident
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Trinity flash explained away as an ammo dump accident, about 1945 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: wondering what had happened and then the government saying, "Oh, we had a accident in an ammo dump."

plain: In 1945 the United States set off the world's first atomic bomb at a desert test site in New Mexico called Trinity. A scientist, Dr. John Brandenburg, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, passes on what he was told: people nearby saw the flash and wondered what had happened, and the government told them it was just an accident at an ammunition dump. He tells it as an example of the government hiding what really went on in New Mexico at the time.
